title: checkin.c stack-usage Werror breaks coap-subsystem builds
description: At d33b6a5956, building any config that enables LICHEN_COAP (e.g. lichen/tests/coap_client) against the local Attic Zephyr 4.1.0 workspace fails: lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/checkin.c:1722 lichen_rollcall_render 'stack usage might be 3424 bytes [-Werror=stack-usage=]' (module sets -Wstack-usage=2048 -Werror). Default-y LICHEN_CHECKIN pulls it into every LICHEN_COAP build. Need: shrink stack frame (render() likely has large locals) or raise the per-file budget/build-time assert. Note: checkin files have concurrent worker WIP (checkin OSCORE gating landed as 2cf5c25a93) - coordinate before fixing. Repro: west build -b qemu_x86/atom lichen/tests/coap_client -DZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=<repo>/lichen with ZEPHYR_BASE=4.1.0 workspace.
